conservative.read: This conservative plan targets approximately 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration, but also limits upside potential. Expect lower drawdowns with this approach.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding quality tech names. Expect moderate drawdowns and growth potential.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single name mandate.
Reduce SMH to 10% as it is flagged for trimming.

Buy CRWV at 6%, NVDA at 5%, and PLTR at 5% from the scanner's best setups.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets approximately 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this approach carries substantially higher drawdown risk and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay/rebalancing.
